# LULCkit

> Open-source GeoTIFF cartography, Land Use / Land Cover (LULC) classification, spectral index, and area-reporting toolkit (MIT License).

## Live Services
- Website & Client-Side Browser GeoTIFF Studio: https://madeshchkma.github.io/LULCkit/
- Interactive Bogura 10m Demo Map: https://madeshchkma.github.io/LULCkit/demo/Bogura_Boro_Map_10m_2026_map.html
- Cloud PyTorch ML Studio (Hugging Face Spaces ZeroGPU): https://huggingface.co/spaces/madeshchakma/LULCkit
- Source Repository (Python CLI & Package): https://github.com/madeshchkma/LULCkit

## Core Capabilities
- `lulc inspect <tif>`: Profiles CRS/WKT, GSD in meters, WGS84 bounds/centroid, COG layout, GDAL/TIFF tags, and band statistics.
- `lulc map <tif>`: Runs O(1)-RAM tiled LULC inference (`rgb-oem` SegFormer-B4, `rgb-fast` SegFormer-B0, `s2-dw` Dynamic World, `categorical` pass-through) and exports colored GeoTIFFs, A4/A5/A3/Letter print maps (`png`/`pdf`/`svg`), CSV/JSON reports, GeoJSON polygons, and MapLibre GL JS HTML viewers.
- `lulc bands <tif>`: Exports custom RGB composites (`true-color`, `false-color-nir`, `agriculture`, `swir`) and stream-computes `NDVI`, `NDWI`, `NDBI`, `SAVI`, and `EVI`.
- `lulc clip <tif> <geojson>`: Clips georeferenced rasters to polygon boundaries preserving colormaps and tags.
- Browser Studio (`docs/`): 100% client-side inspection, categorical palette styling, spectral indices, MapLibre overlays, and PNG/CSV/JSON export via `geotiff.js`, `proj4`, and HTML5 Canvas.
